title: Opa Pa Displacement Of Realities
description: A mod that reworks the game's progression and adds several new features. explore world, build factories, explore space, but for now, that's in progress. For more information, see the description.
body:
A mod that reworks the game's progression and adds several new features.You can also now find displacement of realities in your world and use them, but to do this you will need equipment, which will require you to go a long way in creating factories and traveling to other planets. For now, this is only in the plans, but soon you may be able to see all this in the mod.

Anything related to factories will appear starting with version 2.0.0.a, and anything related to space starting with version 3.0.0.a

I can't add custom crafts to JEI, so you can see the crafts on Discord

I don't recommend adding it to your builds, it is just mod that made by schoolboy in MCreator, honestly, I didn't even want to make it public in the first place. but if you want to play with something new, you can download this mod.
